description:
The superlight, innovative children's bike with 16″ wheels, a safety-conscious design, BMX-style bars, and automatic two-speed shifting for kids aged 4 and up. Kickstand included.

⚡ EXCLUSIVE LAUNCH EXTRAS: The limited-edition colorway qualifies for a FREE pair of woom x Lusso Cloud shoes while supplies last ($55 value)!

How to claim your free shoes: 1. Select your limited-edition neon lime GO bike, and add it to your cart. 2. Navigate to the Lusso Cloud shoe page. 3. Select your preferred shoe size and add them to your cart. *

components.description: Sealed cartridge

Two independently operated mini V-brakes requiring minimal strength for maximum braking power; Ergonomic brake levers designed for small hands with short fingers and little strength; High-quality Jagwire Bowden cables with low friction for smooth performance; Rear brake: green brake lever and brake pads
12 teeth
18 teeth
Lightweight, forged 95 mm aluminum cranks with narrow tread (Q-factor)
Lightweight aluminum unicrown fork; 1″ steerer tube; Generous trail angle for easy, well-balanced handling

Ergonomic design; Ultra slim, child-specific diameter to ensure good grip; Targeted comfort zone for ultimate hand-to-bar contact; Oversized ends for protection in the event of a crash; Lock-on grips with integrated anti-twist clamp

Wide, ergonomic and lightweight aluminum bars for more control; BMX style with high rise for maximum adjustability; ABC marking for precise adjustment in relation to the saddle height; Sandblasted and anodized in black; Super narrow diameter grip, suitable even for very small hands; Width: 500 mm
Fully integrated 1″ headset; Sealed industrial-grade bearings; Integrated Ahead plug
Low-maintenance automatic two-speed hub gearing
15 mm wrench for pedals and rear wheel hub; 4 mm hex key for stem
Narrow, flat platform plastic pedals
Ergonomic design; Durable, waterproof and weather-resistant material

Anodized aluminum seatpost with visible minimum insertion mark; Integrated shim in the seat tube to stop scratching; ABC marking for precise adjustment of the saddle height in relation to the handlebars
Made of aluminum; Long quick-release lever, easy to operate requiring only minimal strength; No risk of turning and/or twisting

Superlight stem made out of forged aluminum; 40 mm/+15°; Recessed clamp bolts and sleek, rounded design making the stem extremely knee-friendly; Handlebars attached to the stem with two 5 mm hexagon socket bolts

16 × 1.4″ Schwalbe Little Joe; High-quality, very light tires with low rolling resistance for maximum safety with minimum effort; Schrader (car-type) valves allowing the tires to be pumped up at gas stations; Reflective stripes for side visibility
Flexible rubber ring linking the fork and frame; Stabilizes steering; Prevents falls caused by overturning the handlebars
No coaster brake, with the unrestricted, free pedal position enabling your child to set off with more ease

Ultralight aluminum rims; Front: lightweight aluminum hub with sealed bearings; installation and removal with 5 mm hex key; Rear: Sturmey-Archer Automatic A2 hub gearing with sealed bearings; installation and removal with 15 mm spanner; 16 lightweight, super strong stainless steel spokes, crossed spoking
